Name: Shane is now working in Pierre's Shop for 1.6
Author: witchtopia
Description:
After the Community Center is completed and Joja is shut down, Shane begins working at Pierre's instead!

[b]MOD FEATURES:[/b]
A new cutscene showing Pierre offering Shane the job.
Three work positions. Stocking shelves, checkout counter, and a scheduled break.
Work schedule of 9-5 Monday thru Friday with occasional days off for festivals and Ginger Island trips, if unlocked.
New Pierre's work uniform, which is just a recolored version of his Joja uniform tbh.
Special dialogue for Shane, Pierre, Caroline, Abigail, Marnie, and Jas.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7940]Stardew Kids Expansion[/url] integration with dialogue for Adrian, if mod is installed.
Configurable portrait options to be compatible with popular portrait replacement mods (requests welcome!)


[b]HOW TO ACTIVATE MOD:[/b]
Walk into Pierre's any day after the Community Center is complete to trigger a cutscene. From there, Shane will work for Pierre!
Multiplayer compatible, but the host should trigger the cutscene first to keep things smooth.

[b]FUTURE PLANS:[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23979]Law and Order SV[/url] integration with Shane stepping up when Pierre is in jail if mod is installed.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27043?tab=description]Romantic Revenue[/url] integration with Shane bringing home a salary from the seed shop if mod is installed.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9999]Always Raining in the Valley[/url] integration with Shane acknowledging Sterling if mod is installed.

Find the original mod [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6426]here[/url]! Mine is pretty different from the OG at this point, but credit where credit's due.
